title: 32x Vanilla World Gen
description: Biomes are thirty-two times the width of vanilla. You will be in the same biome for a long time.
body:
# 32x Vanilla World Gen

Climate zones are so large that finding a biome boundary requires real commitment. Good for builds that need a massive single-biome area, or survival worlds where variety has to be earned.

## Features
- All 5 climate parameters scaled: temperature, vegetation, continentalness, erosion, and weirdness
- Biomes 32x wider than vanilla, eight times the size of Large Biomes
- Normal world type (no presets required)
- Part of the Vanilla World Gen series: 2x · 4x · 8x · 16x · 32x · 64x

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Create a new world (Normal type)
3. Load in. Only affects ungenerated chunks.

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack, no mods, no executables
